A <br> inside a fenced code block stays a real newline, not a split span

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<pre><code>A<br>B</code></pre>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
